# Weak fixture draft (fixture-only synthetic)

## Introduction

This report looks at sustainability in a supply chain and why it matters. It sets out some drivers and benefits and then closes.

## Drivers of sustainability-centric SCM

Regulation, customer pressure, and cost are the main drivers. A supply chain faces all three at once, and the pressure has grown since 2020.

## Benefits of integrating sustainability

There are many benefits. A supply chain can save energy, cut waste, and improve its public image. These are all positive outcomes.

## Conclusion

Sustainability is important for a supply chain and firms should do more of it. The report has covered the main points.
